summary: noxleys@1.0.0: Baileys-derivative WhatsApp library with unverified media/network utilities
details: Package appears to be a fork or derivative of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library. lib/Utils/messages-media.js imports child_process, os, http, and https and performs HTTP GET/POST/fetch operations, including calls to https://mmg.whatsapp.net (a documented WhatsApp media host). Buffer.from(...) calls appear in chat-utils.js and messages-media.js consistent with base64/binary handling for the WhatsApp protocol. Without a full trace of the network destinations and payload contents, it cannot be confirmed whether all outbound traffic is confined to first-party WhatsApp infrastructure or whether additional destinations receive caller data; the primitives are also consistent with the legitimate media upload/download and codec-invocation paths used by Baileys.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
